## Setup

Icebound Beam (channeled) vs the standard dummy, with Icy Blade firing.

## Raw data points

Validated in-game: the Cold Beam drops to **1/3** once any Icy Blade fires.

## Derived / confirmed formula

Cold Beam is **suppressed to 1/3** while Icy Blade is active (a redistribution, not an additive change). General channeled skills otherwise scale smoothly (cap 30/s).

## Notes / caveats / open questions

The suppression is the key gotcha for the channeled framework.
